name: Sentiment on developer social posts
description: Classify the sentiment of short developer-community posts (Bluesky / Mastodon style).

payload.text: Just shipped my first MCP server in 30 minutes. The Spring AI starter is ridiculously smooth.
Wasted three hours fighting with hibernate jsonb columns. There has to be a better way.
The pgvector 1.0 release notes mention HNSW improvements.
Love how fast Claude 4.7 is — but the rate limits on the cheap plan are brutal.

units.goldExplanation: Praises speed AND complains about rate limits.

payload.text: Spent the weekend reading AGENTS.md guides. Big fan of the convention.
Postmortem published: vector DB outage took down embeddings ingest for 4h.
Anyone else seeing flaky tool calls on Sonnet 4.6 today?
Migrated 12 services to OpenTelemetry over the weekend. Honestly delightful.
Why does every framework reinvent dependency injection.
Reading the new MCP spec changes. Solid additions for streaming tools.
First time using Vite — the dev server speed is genuinely a different sport.
